results.name: Rolypolies debut in Level 2 wave 2 with their hint, and come back in L2 W5, L2 W8 and L3 W7
A credited touch curls it, it rolls away from the touch as a ghost, bowls pins as credited chains, then blooms
A roll plays out the same at 30, 60 and 144 FPS
A chain, a power or an uncredited strike blooms it plainly, with no roll
Seeds pass through a rolling rolypoly, and a roll aimed at the line turns back without costing a life
A Lullaby freezes a roll where it is, and it carries on after
The bot values a rolypoly by the pins its roll would cross, and forecasts a rolling one as a ghost
foes.js never touches the seed pod and never uses Math.random
